mapper.sql: select s.stock_id, coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') as item_type, coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) as item_id, s.product_id, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.oe_item_code when 'gift' then gift.gift_code else p.product_code end as item_code, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.oe_item_name when 'gift' then gift.gift_name else p.product_name end as item_name, s.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, s.warehouse_id, warehouse_dept.dept_name as warehouse_name, s.current_quantity, s.locked_quantity, s.available_quantity, s.cost_price, s.total_cost, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.cost_price when 'gift' then gift.cost_price else p.cost_price end as reference_cost_price, s.version, s.batch_no, s.expiry_date, s.serial_no, s.location_code, s.location_name, s.last_in_time, s.last_out_time, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.category_id, c.category_name, ( select group_concat(pc.category_name order by find_in_set(pc.category_id, concat(c.ancestors, ',', c.category_id)) separator ' / ') from inv_product_category pc where pc.del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(pc.category_id, concat(c.ancestors, ',', c.category_id)) > 0 ) as category_full_path, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oc.category_name when 'gift' then gc.category_name else c.category_name end as item_category_name, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then ( select group_concat(oct.category_name order by find_in_set(oct.category_id, concat(oc.ancestors, ',', oc.category_id)) separator ' / ') from inv_oe_category oct where oct.del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(oct.category_id, concat(oc.ancestors, ',', oc.category_id)) > 0 ) when 'gift' then ( select group_concat(gct.category_name order by find_in_set(gct.category_id, concat(gc.ancestors, ',', gc.category_id)) separator ' / ') from inv_gift_category gct where gct.del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(gct.category_id, concat(gc.ancestors, ',', gc.category_id)) > 0 ) else ( select group_concat(pc.category_name order by find_in_set(pc.category_id, concat(c.ancestors, ',', c.category_id)) separator ' / ') from inv_product_category pc where pc.del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(pc.category_id, concat(c.ancestors, ',', c.category_id)) > 0 ) end as item_category_full_path, p.grade, p.spec, p.unit, p.safety_stock_min, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.image_url when 'gift' then gift.image_url else p.image_url end as image_url, p.package_image_url, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.order_unit when 'gift' then gift.replenishment_unit else p.unit end as item_unit, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.item_description when 'gift' then gift.spec else p.spec end as item_spec, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'gift' then gift.grade else p.grade end as item_grade, p.dry_tea_image_url, p.tea_soup_image_url, p.leaf_bottom_image_url, p.extra_image_url, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from inv_stock s left join inv_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join inv_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join inv_oe_item oe on coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') = 'oe' and oe.oe_item_id = coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) and oe.del_flag = '0' left join inv_oe_category oc on oc.category_id = oe.category_id and oc.del_flag = '0' left join inv_gift_box gift on coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') = 'gift' and gift.gift_id = coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) and gift.del_flag = '0' left join inv_gift_category gc on gc.category_id = gift.category_id and gc.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id left join sys_dept warehouse_dept on warehouse_dept.dept_id = s.warehouse_id
mapper.select: select count(1) as stock_item_count, count(distinct s.shop_dept_id) as shop_count, count(distinct s.warehouse_id) as warehouse_count, coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) <= coalesce(p.safety_stock_min, 10) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as warning_count, coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) > 0 and coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) <= coalesce(p.safety_stock_min, 10) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as low_stock_count, coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) <= 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as zero_stock_count, coalesce(sum(s.current_quantity), 0) as total_current_quantity, coalesce(sum(s.locked_quantity), 0) as total_locked_quantity, coalesce(sum(s.available_quantity), 0) as total_available_quantity, coalesce(sum(s.total_cost), 0) as total_cost, coalesce(sum(case when #{selectedWarehouseId} is not null and s.warehouse_id = #{selectedWarehouseId} then s.current_quantity else 0 end), 0) as my_warehouse_quantity, coalesce(sum(case when #{selectedWarehouseId} is null or s.warehouse_id is null or s.warehouse_id != #{selectedWarehouseId} then s.current_quantity else 0 end), 0) as other_shop_quantity from inv_stock s left join inv_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join inv_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join inv_oe_item oe on coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') = 'oe' and oe.oe_item_id = coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) and oe.del_flag = '0' left join inv_oe_category oc on oc.category_id = oe.category_id and oc.del_flag = '0' left join inv_gift_box gift on coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') = 'gift' and gift.gift_id = coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) and gift.del_flag = '0' left join inv_gift_category gc on gc.category_id = gift.category_id and gc.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into inv_stock ( item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version, batch_no, expiry_date, serial_no, location_code, location_name, last_in_time, last_out_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( coalesce(#{itemType}, 'product'), coalesce(#{itemId}, #{productId}), #{productId}, #{shopDeptId}, #{warehouseId}, #{currentQuantity}, #{lockedQuantity}, #{availableQuantity}, #{costPrice}, #{totalCost}, coalesce(#{version}, 0), #{batchNo}, #{expiryDate}, #{serialNo}, #{locationCode}, #{locationName}, #{lastInTime}, #{lastOutTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update inv_stock set current_quantity = current_quantity + #{quantity}, available_quantity = available_quantity + #{quantity}, last_in_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where stock_id = #{stockId} and version = #{version}

update inv_stock set cost_price = (coalesce(total_cost, 0) + #{incomingCost}) / (coalesce(current_quantity, 0) + #{quantity}), current_quantity = coalesce(current_quantity, 0) + #{quantity}, available_quantity = coalesce(available_quantity, 0) + #{quantity}, total_cost = coalesce(total_cost, 0) + #{incomingCost}, last_in_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where stock_id = #{stockId} and version = #{version}

update inv_stock set current_quantity = current_quantity - #{quantity}, available_quantity = available_quantity - #{quantity}, last_out_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where stock_id = #{stockId} and version = #{version} and available_quantity >= #{quantity}

update inv_stock set current_quantity = coalesce(current_quantity, 0) - #{quantity}, available_quantity = coalesce(available_quantity, 0) - #{quantity}, total_cost = total_cost - #{deductCost}, last_out_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where stock_id = #{stockId} and version = #{version} and available_quantity >= #{quantity} and #{quantity} > 0 and current_quantity >= #{quantity} and cost_price >= 0 and total_cost >= #{deductCost} and #{deductCost} >= 0 and (current_quantity != #{quantity} or total_cost = #{deductCost})
